checks.accepted: Unique run-specific EvidenceStore refuses overwrite and preserves19 case/stage snapshots before reset. Every copied canonical/metadata/revision/ledger/derived file hash and every manifest hash matches readback; explicit absent files match. All9 declared module/schema bindings match start/end, final receipt hash matches pointer, and failed history remains.
checks.defect: Only restore_recovery_interrupt has requested before/interrupted/first/second stage set; most cases save only final/second state, and changed-payload/post-oplog/replay cases have no immutable evidence directory. checks.correction: Retain original named journal bytes with manifest hashes and exact required per-case stage files; verify copied manifests/files after saving and at acceptance. Preserve explicit absences and refuse overwrite. Add evidence for collision, post-oplog invalidation/retry and historical replay.
